control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at TX-8001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-8001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-8001 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 21 January 2015 a hazard report was recorded on TX-8001 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
